review_text: Just returned from a stay at the Tropicana, stayed here before quite a few years ago. I love the relaxed vibe about it and the very spacious apartments, though a chest of drawers would be a massive help in the bedroom. Excellent staff and facilities. My only negative, would be the Siesta next door using the hotel, beach and pool. They should have booked the Tropicana in the first place? There's a guy on the beach opposite the hotel, who looks after the sunbeds, but doesn't really monitor it well enough, people in the Jasmin and siesta were using the beds, sometimes he told them no and pointed to their beach area or just ignored them and carried on chatting to his friends or just sat and smoked. It was easy if it was the Jasmin, as they wore blue wristbands, as it was an all inclusive, perhaps the Tropicana and Siesta should have their own coloured wrist bands, just to make it easier? Being by the pool was almost an all inclusive vibe, you definitely got better service there, food and drinks being brought to your beds, but the beds are very close together and big groups of people hung out together laughing, smoking ,which if you want to chill would be impossible, equally the siesta were told they could use the pool, so limited your use of that area. The supermarket had very limited choice, drinks at the bar were expensive and the food ok. We chose to go out every night for food, as there's lots of choice in the main town or along the coastal path. The walk into Gumbet town by road, was very dark in places and the pavement uneven, didn't feel very safe, equally the coastal path was dirty and dark in places too, it just looked tired and lots of litter around. I would recommend a visit to Bitez, very chilled out place, fab places to eat and spotless, no sellers hassling you, equally preferred Bodrum by night, great places to eat and you have the castle and harbour. I would of course come back and appreciate when you choose this time of year to come away, with it being the end of season, you can just tell workers at hotels/restaurants/shops can't wait to finish, so maybe the service isn't as attentive, as at the start and thru the summer months. Cleaners and bar staff at Tropicana always cheerful tho.

Really enjoyed the holiday but a few things let it down... The hotel would be even better if they had a microwave in the apartments and during our week stay there was no entertainment. review_text: We had an average stay overall. There were definitely some positives, but unfortunately the negatives outweighed them enough that we wouldn’t choose to stay here again. The hotel also seems to be mainly geared towards the Turkish and Russian holidaymakers, so the atmosphere felt a little more tailored to that clientele than to a broader mix of guests. The best thing about this hotel is the location. There are loads of local bars and restaurants within walking distance, which you’ll probably end up using if the hotel food doesn’t improve. There are also quite a few local shops in the area selling bags, clothes, shoes, snacks and drinks. The beach is lovely with great views, and the pool is a good size and kept nice and clean. There were no issues getting sun beds even at 10 or 11am. The drinks were decent quality, and the Pink Pool Party was a lot of fun. The restaurant and evening entertainment area are also really well designed and create a lovely atmosphere. We also liked being able to order food through the app to the restaurant – although it would be even better if you could order drinks at the same time. We also couldn’t fault any of the restaurant staff, as they were all very helpful. A few things let the hotel down. The surrounding area is quite lively with several nightclubs nearby, so if you’re a light sleeper I’d definitely recommend bringing earplugs. The noise didn’t bother us personally, but it’s worth knowing before you book. The pool DJ also needs to mix things up a bit. Hearing the same three songs on repeat multiple times every day gets very repetitive after the first couple of days! The biggest disappointment was the food. It was almost always cold, despite being advertised as freshly prepared. The only consistently hot food we had during our stay was the pizza, which was actually very good. Another issue was the amount of smoking in the dining area. It really isn’t pleasant trying to enjoy a meal while constantly smelling cigarette smoke. We’d love to see a dedicated non-smoking section in the restaurant, as this became incredibly frustrating throughout our stay. The bar staff seemed quite young and inexperienced, and when it was busy they could come across as quite rude. It might help to have two staff on the bar making drinks instead of leaving it up to one young lad. The rooms have clearly been refurbished on a budget. There was loose wiring, dodgy plumbing, and the balconies were tiny. On top of that, quite a few of the sun loungers around the pool were either broken or very worn out. Overall, we had an okay holiday with some enjoyable moments, but there are too many areas that need improving. Sadly, we wouldn’t stay here again.

I was there with my 8 month old son and wife recently and we picked Paradise Garden Apart to stay there, and that was a perfect pick , thanks to some friends who knew about this place. It is a little paradise with a nice garden a swimming pool . The most important is that it is a baby friendly place, Ayse Teyze , is a great help in finding fresh, organic food for your baby or kids. She will be happy to let you use her kitchen if you need to cook something special for your baby.. If you are traveling with your kids and if you happen to be in Gumusluk ,Paradise is your place. No hesitation in recommending it. It is 2 mins away from the Beach and the shore is lined with several small and big scale restaurants.

review_text: Disappointment beyond the pretty picture: excellent grounds with a complete lack of service. The hotel leaves very mixed, but primarily negative, impressions. The reality completely fails to match the beautiful photos on the website! The main and most significant drawback is the rooms and the service, which is simply nonexistent: the rooms are dirty, the furniture and decor don't match the photos on the website. We arrived late and were greeted by a completely unprepared room—there weren't even the most basic extra bed linens and towels! We had to clean the room ourselves that night, as they couldn't provide another room, which was even worse. It felt like guests weren't welcome here at all. During our entire stay, there was no cleaning at all. Not at all. The only positive aspects are the natural and architectural aspects: the hotel grounds themselves are truly beautiful and well-maintained. The beach, although small, was always spacious and there weren't many people. The sea is magnificent (clean and refreshing), but there's no gradual entry; it's deep right away (for some, this might be a deciding factor). The concept and grounds are wonderful, but the terrible service, the dirt, and the lack of attention to room preparation completely ruin the entire vacation experience. I don't recommend it until the hotel improves its cleaning and basic hospitality.

review_text: Such a beautiful location, yet such terrible management... If you're planning a reservation at this hotel, I suggest you take my review below into consideration beforehand. You might even avoid this hotel solely because of the person named ER..N (grey-haired) who manages the pool and beach area. There's no problem with charging for food and drinks at the beach bar/restaurant. But you can't charge for water everywhere in the hotel, for goodness sake! This person's eyes are always on you, driven by a desire to make money; customer comfort and convenience are secondary. If they were, the beach would be tidy, clean, and well-maintained. The sea is naturally clean, and that's what makes the hotel attractive. The situation that I'm complaining about, and that humiliated me in front of everyone, is that one morning when I went down to the beach early to swim, the person in question couldn't even respond to my "good morning." He was busy staring at the towel in my hand with a skeptical look. Around 9 am, after swimming, as I was returning to my room from the breakfast area, this person blocked my way and had the audacity to say that if I didn't take the towel from the sun lounger within an hour, he would have my towel collected. The fact that he did this in front of other guests, making me feel like I'd committed a shameful crime, proves why the hotel only received a 3 rating. Okay, leaving towels early is something I hate too, but I've already swum and I'm going to get my child from the room and come back down, so this kind of behavior is rude. To use an analogy, would you tell a guest in your house, "Don't forget to lift the toilet seat"? Go away, sir, don't give me a lecture on morality. You're the homeowner. Since you're responsible for the pool and beach area, first ensure the cleanliness and safety of the pool. It's covered in rust and dirt, cigarette butts in the children's pool, and most importantly, rusty nails and screws left exposed in the same area. A murky pool, rusty railings, and the rooms are inadequately cleaned. Just so you know, they don't go into the rooms to clean them. They leave you with a mop full of dirty customer hair, and they expect you to clean it. You will need to buy your own detergent and wipe the floor. The hotel has no security at the entrance; entry is left to God's mercy. I came here expecting comfort and quality based on the reviews, but the behavior of a person named Er...n could ruin your vacation. For your information.

review_text: We stayed with my wife in September 2022. Pros; -We only stayed in the apart room. We did not experience the restaurant. The view and location are extraordinary. The sunset view is especially beautiful. - The price is quite affordable. The staff is attentive, and since the terrain is hilly, they carry you to your room with their vehicles. - Open car park is available and we could always find a place. Cons; -Room cleaning is not bad except for the walls, but the walls are full of dead flies. There is a lot of fly problem. - It was written in the room that if the dishes are not left clean, an extra fee will be charged. I think Unnecessary should be involved in room cleaning. - The land is very sloping, you will be too lazy to go up and down to the sea. But this makes the view of most rooms perfect. - Since the price is affordable, people who do not know themselves can come. This situation may not have anything directly to do with money, but you will realize through experience that you are less likely to encounter such people in expensive places. On the first day of our holiday, while standing with my pregnant wife near the stairs in the sea, we were subjected to unfair harassment by an old lady, as if she was blocking the road. You may have to deal with such people during your holiday when you are trying to boost your morale. - It is very difficult to reach if you do not have a car.

There's no one in the hotel who cares about you, and if you have a negative review, they won't even look at you. hotel_name: Costa Farilya Special Class Hotel Bodrum
review_text: I stayed here for 2 nights while attending a friends wedding. The staff,although not many were English speakers, were so friendly and helpful to a guest visiting their country. I don’t go to another country expecting the locals to speak English, so this wasn’t a problem for me. They have English versions of the menus etc and with a bit of patience and a few laughs we worked together. The rooms are clean and tidy, though I did have a bathroom issue. The shower tray isn’t deep enough nor the glass screen big enough which means the bathroom floor becomes flooded if you don’t put loads of towels down. This doesn’t bother me but does result in a heavier work load for the cleaners. The area is beautiful with lots of restaurants and bars. The locals are friendly, and wasn’t over charged once in local shops. On the day of the wedding I realised I had forgotten to get my clothes pressed and the hotel staff rushed my shirt and trousers through their laundry service, with only an hour to go they got my clothes back to me in emmaculate condition. Would definitely stay here again!

review_text: Geçen senede konakladığım ve denize olan mesafe avantajı genel ortamı kahvaltı kalitesi nedeniyle erken rezervasyon yaptırdığım ( Bugün yapsam sadece 4.000 TL avantaj sağlamış vaziyetteyim asla değmedi) otel ile ilgili önce güzel şeyleri söylemek isterim. Gündoğan denizi çok güzel ön taraflardaki odanızdan denize ulaşmanız 4-5 dk. Sabah 10:00 da bizi odamıza aldılar bir sürü kedi var.... Bunlar güzel olanlar. Banyo kapısı kilitli kaldı, açtırdık. Taharet musluğu elimizde kaldı biz takabildik. Otelin kullanım suyu o kadar tuzlu ki benim saçlarım kaskatı oldu. Odamızın konumu güzeldi. Resepsiyon girişte restoranlarını İtalyan konpeti ile yeni bir işletmeye teslim ettiklerini belirttiler bizde ilk akşam deneyimledik. İlk ve sondu. Fiyat performans olarak çok çok kötü bir işletme. Bu işletme aynı zamanda plaj kısmına da hizmet ediyor maalesef. Eşim bonfile ben köfte oğlum dana madalyan istedi. Tabaklarımız gelince büyük bir hayal kırıklığına uğradık 1.400- 1.600 TL arasında tabak başına para ödediğimiz en üzücü tabak dana madalyonu tercih eden oğlumun tabağı idi, 3 döner parçası büyüklüğünde et ve yanında baby patates beni köftelerimin bir kısmı yanık bir kısmı çiğ, eşimin bonfilesi üzücü bir boyutta asla değmez asla... Lezzet kısmı ise bu fiyatlama nedeniyle söylemiyorum gerçekten son derece standart.. Plaj kısmında 2 su 2 soda 600 TL sular küçük ve plastik şişede.. 3 dk yürüyerek gittiğiniz tekelde ise 2 su 2 soda 60 TL aynı ürünler tabii ki otelde ciddi boş oda var. Plaja günlük kullananlar uzun süre hesap öderken bilgi fişine bakıyor. Nasıl bir çarpanla sadece dolapta tuttukları ve maliyet olarak elektrik ve size ulaştıran ilgilinin maliyeti olan bir ürün 10 katı pahalı olabilir. Tekelde para kazanıyor sonuçta aynı marka ürünlere 60 TL vererek erişebiliyorsunuz...Saat 17 itibarı ile ola ki şezlong üzerinde havlu dışında bir eşyanız yok ise kapıyorlar havluyu. Tekrar havlu için resepsiyona gidilmeli... Sabah 8 de denize girmek için gittiğinizde en iyi yerleri beach işletmecileri havlularla kapatmış siz ısrar ederseniz kaldırıyorlar havluyu efendim sadece 10 şezlong kapattık vs diyorlar. Pizza yedik hamuru güzeldi. Aynı pizzayı Türkbükü Gölköy deki marka mekanlarda sadece%10 daha yüksek fiyata ebat ve içerik olarak ideal kıvamda yiyebilirsiniz...Kısacası Gündoğan ın denizi güzel bu zihniyetteki işletmeler neleri kimlere teslim ettiğinin farkına varmadan daha da az odaya daha da vasat işletme zihniyetine daha da az doluluk oranlarına mahkum. Kahvaltı kalitesi de geçen seneye göre son derece düşüktü. Aktarmadan geçemeyeceğim şayet biraz ucundan kıyısından tanınır birileriyseniz tanınırlığınız tartışılır bu arada... Kalpli pizza ile foto paylaşıp öneren zihniyetin pazarlamadaki yaklaşımı bana kadar şeklinde oluyor maalesef... Kahvaltıda hizmet eden genç kızlarımız çok misafirperverdi. Kendilerine teşekkürlerimle...

review_text: We had a wonderful Time at this hotel. The staff were friendly and helpful. We had a beautiful suite with sun lounges on the balcony overlooking the ocean with magnificent views. The hotel is modern with all the necessary amenities. Breakfast is fresh and there is a good selection. The staff only wanted to help us and please. In afternoon , a DJ plays in the bar which creates a good vibe. There are decks built overlooking the water which have sun loungers ( be warned people keep them for hours on end without occupying them) . One can easily jump into the ocean or use steps provided to go for a swim in the clear ocean. Views are fantastic. The resort has water sports that one can book for a very costly fee. The concierge was wonderful and made some excellent restaurant recommendations and even booked us a beach club for the day which I would highly recommend. There are some lovely Restuarants 1.2 km away at the marina that serve wonderful fresh fish and meat. Some things I did notice which would make this hotel even better are: People tend to put their items down on the sun loungers very early and only arrive hours later and at times not at all, leaving those that genuinely want to sit on the loungers not able too do so. A policy of some sort should be implemented for this. It’s very unpleasant on holiday to worry about not getting a lounger. There was no information supplied about the hotel ( lots of QR codes for room service etc). No information supplied on any activities , which Restuarant’s they had and where. The hotel is priced in euros .and is expensive. Turkish Lira would be an advantage too. Most resorts have a happy hour or food and beverage special .There was no such thing at Mivara. Some background music whilst sitting on the loungers on the decks would be nice. Overall we had a wonderful stay and would definitely book again at Mivara.

review_text: Our stay at La Blanche Island Bodrum exceeded all our expectations. From the moment we arrived, we were impressed by the hotel’s unique location on a beautiful peninsula, surrounded by breathtaking views of the Aegean Sea. The spacious and elegant reception area immediately gave us a luxurious first impression, and every member of the staff was incredibly kind, welcoming, and helpful throughout our entire stay. Our room was spacious, modern, and spotlessly clean. It was cleaned every day, and the minibar was refilled daily with soft drinks and bottled water. These little touches made our holiday even more comfortable. The pools are fantastic, always clean and well-maintained. The water slides were a huge hit with our daughter, who couldn’t wait to go back every day. The private beach is beautiful, with crystal-clear water, and one thing we really appreciated was that we never had to “fight” for a sunbed. No matter what time we arrived, there were always plenty available. Fresh beach towels were provided every day, which was another great convenience. The food was excellent in every way. The main restaurant offered an incredible variety of fresh and delicious dishes at every meal. The Starbucks on the resort opens at noon and is a great place to enjoy a quality coffee or refreshing drink. The Sweet Corner serves delicious ice cream, fresh fruit, and freshly made waffles throughout the day, while the dessert bar in the lobby offers a wonderful selection of cakes and pastries for anyone with a sweet tooth. In the evenings, the Lobby Bar became our favourite place to relax before or after the shows, serving excellent cocktails in a lovely atmosphere. During the day, we spent a lot of time at the Pool Bar, where Mehmet made the best cocktails in the hotel. He is not only an incredibly talented bartender but also one of the friendliest and most attentive people we met. After just a few days, he already remembered our favourite drinks and always welcomed us with a smile. We truly enjoyed chatting with him every day, and he became one of the highlights of our holiday. The evening entertainment was excellent every single night, with professional shows, live music, children’s performances, followed by DJ parties and dancing. There was always something enjoyable for guests of every age. During the day, the Entertainment Team, led by Sercan, did a fantastic job organizing sports and pool activities. Aqua fitness, water games, beach volleyball, and many other activities created a fun atmosphere throughout the day. Sercan and his team were energetic, friendly, and enthusiastic without ever being pushy. They made everyone feel welcome and encouraged participation in a relaxed and enjoyable way. Families with children will also appreciate the Kids Club, which is open throughout the day. review_text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An Unforgettable Holiday at La Blanche Island, Bodrum We had yet another incredible stay at La Blanche Island and can honestly say it is still the best hotel i have ever been to. From the moment we arrived, we were blown away by the stunning location and breathtaking views that surround the island. Wherever you looked, there were spectacular panoramic sea views, crystal-clear waters, and beautiful scenery that made every day feel special. The hotel itself is outstanding – immaculately maintained, beautifully designed, and offering everything you could possibly need for a relaxing and enjoyable holiday. The facilities were excellent, and the attention to detail throughout the resort was impressive. The food was another highlight of our stay. The Turkish à la carte restaurant was exceptional and an absolute must-visit. Every dish was full of flavour, beautifully presented, and gave us a wonderful taste of authentic Turkish cuisine. The quality of food throughout the resort was consistently excellent. What truly sets La Blanche Island apart, however, is its people. Every member of staff we encountered was friendly, welcoming, and genuinely happy to help. From the housekeeping team who kept our room spotless, to the waiters and waitresses who always served us with a smile, the reception staff who were professional and accommodating, and even the gardeners who work tirelessly to keep the grounds looking beautiful – everyone contributed to making our stay memorable. A very special thank you goes to the entertainment team, especially Murat, whose energy, enthusiasm, and hard work created a fantastic atmosphere throughout our holiday. They made sure there was always something fun happening for both adults and children. We would also like to give special recognition to the wonderful girls at the Kids Club, who were absolutely fantastic with my little girl. Their kindness, patience, and dedication meant she had an amazing time and looked forward to seeing them every day. They truly helped make our holiday extra special. Thank you to everyone at La Blanche Island for giving us such wonderful memories. We can't wait to return for a 3rd visit and would highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a beautiful resort, amazing food, outstanding service, and an unforgettable holiday experience.

review_text: Wow where do I start? We booked over a year ago and were looking forward to it but recent reviews on here and Facebook did make me ponder however I tend to roll my eyes at negative English reviews as they focus on spirits (why?) and food. Well I need not have worried! Firstly it’s important to note it cost us £1900 for a week for 2 adults and 1 child in half term, so my expectations are low, as long as we can swim and there’s at least chips and salad we will survive! Food Considering we are here for the last week of the season I found the food to be fantastic. Slow roasted lamb, beef short ribs, fresh fish and local pasta dishes plus lots of salad and bread choices. Delicious soups. Fabulous omelette bar at breakfast again with lots of options but breakfast is breakfast! I can see why some British don’t like it, there’s no chicken nuggets for a start or pork. So if these things are important book elsewhere. Ala cartes we tried were the two open, Turkish & fish. Both are brilliant. The coffee shop and patisserie are lovely. Ice creams on the beach good too. We don’t drink alcohol so doesn’t phase us. Good soft drink selection. Probably the best coffee I’ve ever had at an AI (swerve the Starbucks imo). Cafe Blanche really is lovely. Location Gorgeous location, so lovely and quiet with a beautiful beach. Again seen lots of moaning about this but honestly it’s the end of October the sea and pool will be cooler! All 3 of us had no issues in swimming though. The sea is my preferred choice. The slides were good fun too ☺️ lots of lovely snorkelling able to be done! We also got a free room upgrade which was AMAZING! I really love that you can get your steps in round this hotel. Spa Had a fantastic deal from Andy, going to try and book another for our last day! Yes they have conferences on but this is the norm in low season across Europe too. None of us were offended by knitted body parts Staff Staff are fantastic, I learnt basic Turkish and would recommend people do this. Really lovely service when tipping people properly. They even charged my kindle at reception for me! The only “negatives” are that entertainment starts at midnight but that doesn’t bother us. I’ve never stayed at the same hotel twice but we are coming back next October we enjoyed it that much ☺️

review_text: We stayed one night at Le Méridien Bodrum Beach Resort, chosen for its amenities and closeness to the airport (just 20 minutes away), and left wishing we had stayed longer. The service was exceptional. Ali Bezir, the Front Office Manager, communicated with us before arrival, preparing everything to our needs. Nacira from Guest Relations was friendly and helpful, while Doğukan and Kubilay made check-in and check-out seamless. Restaurant staff, buggy drivers who ferried us around the hills, and even the playful kittens added warmth to our stay. The Stella Restaurant stood out with an excellent breakfast offering plenty of variety, and dinner was equally enjoyable. Ali kindly arranged for our room to be decorated and surprised our friend with a birthday cake — a beautiful touch that made the evening memorable. Our room was small but offered breathtaking views of the Aegean Sea, visible straight from the bed and even the shower. A modern TV with Google Cast was a great addition, and we enjoyed the beach, the scenic walks, the accessible gym, and a relaxing spa treatment. The only drawback was being told that use of the spa facilities required an extra €38 for 30 minutes, which felt disappointing for a 5-star resort, as I expected basic access to be included. Overall, the staff are the true stars here, making our short visit unforgettable. Highly recommended, especially if you’re looking for luxury close to the airport.

review_text: Rezension – Lujo Hotel Bodrum ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ Das Lujo Hotel in Bodrum ist ein sehr schön eingerichtetes und modernes Hotel, das insgesamt einen hochwertigen Eindruck hinterlässt. Besonders positiv finde ich das à-la-carte-Konzept: Es gibt kein offenes Buffet, wodurch weniger verschwendet wird und die Qualität des Essens hoch bleibt. Die Zimmer sind geschmackvoll eingerichtet und bieten alles, was man von einem Hotel dieser Klasse erwarten kann. Wir waren vier Personen in einem Familienzimmer. Das Zimmer war sehr modern, geräumig und stets sauber – hier gibt es absolut nichts zu bemängeln. Was ich mir jedoch gewünscht hätte, wären zwei Toiletten sowie mehr Steckdosen im Badbereich, da man mit mehreren Personen schnell an Grenzen stößt. Der Strandbereich ist in zwei Teile aufgeteilt: • ein normaler Familienstrand mit Kindern • und der 16+ Indigo Beach Club. Der Indigo-Bereich ist grundsätzlich sehr angenehm, allerdings ist die Musik im Restaurantbereich dort extrem laut – besonders ab ca. 15–16 Uhr bis in den frühen Abend hinein, sodass man sich beim Essen kaum unterhalten kann. Zudem sind die Liegeplätze am 16+ Strand eher begrenzt. Die Speisen sind qualitativ auf sehr hohem Niveau und geschmacklich top – hier gibt es wirklich nichts zu bemängeln. Verbesserungsbedarf sehe ich allerdings bei den Kaffeespezialitäten, die sehr wässrig wirkten, sowie bei den Cocktails: Am Familienstrand eher schwach, im Indigo-Bereich besser, aber noch nicht ganz das Niveau.

review_text: The holiday was an experience. I had a fun time with my friends that was the main thing. We went as a group of young women. However the hotel was questionable. We were suspicious before going what it would be like when we went on Google street view and since it was so cheap/good value for money. So I have to say for the price of the all inclusive hotel I can’t be shocked it was more two star than five star. Starting with the positives the staff we spoke to were really nice and tried to be accommodating despite most didn’t know how to speak English so we did have a language barrier (which is fair enough we were in Turkey). I would say the bad things about the hotel weren’t always something that most staff could overcome and they tried their best. So we give credit to the staff we met. The food was alright pretty much the same food everyday/night. Nothing amazing but it’s edible. The burger and pizza in the sports bar was good. It was a 35 min drive from bodrum town centre which was our favourite day. I guess on to bad things or stuff to be aware of- if you are wanting luxury, good entertainment/fun atmosphere, high quality food and whatever else you’d expect from a five star experience then don’t go here. There was no entertainment when we was there - I think our last day they started to play music from the speaker round the pool but we just entertained ourselves in our room most nights with our own music. Also had harassing guests who wouldn’t leave us alone most nights/days when we said we didn’t want to speak to them etc so they made us feel uncomfortable, constantly staring, pulling up chairs at our table, making their friends come over in a crowd speaking in their language and pointing just wanting to be intimidating when we said no . This made us not want to be in the main lobby either and just hide in our room. So that spoiled our time. Maybe the staff were oblivious but no one intervened or really understood us and this happened Saturday to Wednesday. Whilst the guests who were annoying us aren’t the hotels fault maybe if they see this behaviour next time they should stop it so it doesn’t spoil the next groups holiday.. The area we stayed in was a construction site still, they had rushed our room so it was ready and the decor was nice but rushed and it was missing stuff. We had to ask for a tv remote, air con remote, the electrics for the telephone to contact reception didn’t work, the water was sometimes yellow and there was concrete and mess all in the hallway etc. Most rooms we went in there were holes in ceilings including the indoor pool and leaking from the lobby daily. Just seemed like the hotel shouldn’t have been open and they should have sorted out construction and repair works before taking on guests. Want a massage- hmm that was a questionable experience too for us. This holiday will always make us laugh from the memories but if you want to spend your hard earned money on a nice holiday I would recommend

review_text: I would not recommend this hotel, especially not for a 5-star rating. The manager and reception staff were condescending, despite informing them that I’m six months pregnant and unable to walk uphill to reach my room, they refused to accommodate this and seemed indifferent to whether I cancelled my reservation altogether. The one time I contacted guest relations, to ask about the kids club schedule, they couldn’t even provide that information, I’m still not sure what purpose they serve. The food was by far the worst I’ve experienced at a 5-star hotel. I ended up eating plain white rice and raw vegetables like tomatoes just to get by. Service at the restaurants was equally disappointing. When servers were available, they were grumpy and unpleasant, not even acknowledging a simple thank you. Most of the time they were so overwhelmed that they didn’t clear the tables, we ended up doing it ourselves. The spa staff, on the other hand, were overly pushy, hounding us every time we walked by. On top of that, the internet was extremely poor, we had to pay €20 per person for 4G just to get a working connection. The TVs weren’t smart TVs, so we couldn’t watch Netflix, YouTube, or cast anything from our phones, and out of 100 channels, only one (France 24) was in French Overall, this stay fell far short of what I’d expect from a 5-star property. Between the lack of consideration for my pregnancy, the poor food quality, unhelpful and unpleasant staff, and inadequate amenities, I won’t be returning to this hotel. Update : Following our disappointment, they did offer us a dinner at an à la carte restaurant for our last evening, which was significantly better than the main restaurant. I appreciate the gesture.

review_text: Très très mauvaise expérience ! Un séjour à oublier... que nous avons dû écourter ! En lisant les avis, nous étions confiants dans notre choix de cet hôtel, mais malheureusement, l'expérience a été très décevante. Dès notre arrivée, nous avons été placés dans une chambre avec vue... sur des buissons ! Pourtant, notre réservation mentionnait une chambre avec jardin et vue sur la piscine. Lorsque nous avons demandé à changer de chambre, notre requête a été refusée ! L'hôtel a prétendu ne pas être responsable des annonces et nous a demandé d'attendre le lendemain pour un éventuel changement. Le petit déjeuner laissait à désirer.. Lors de notre deuxième jour, nous avons dû patienter 25 minutes pour être servis, et obtenir un repas complet. Les assiettes arrivaient au compte-gouttes, il a fallu qu’on relance 2 fois pour avoir du thé, le pain afin de commencer notre déjeuner. Quant au SPA, chaque fois que nous nous y rendions, surprise ! Il était fermé. Nous l'avons signalé à la réception à plusieurs reprises, mais on nous a simplement répondu qu'ils ne pouvaient rien faire et qu'il fallait attendre le retour de la personne responsable (en balade en ville). En résumé, cet hôtel soi-disant de luxe déçoit grandement. Mis à part la beauté des chambres, le service laisse à désirer, le personnel est loin d'être serviable et aimable, parfois même arrogant. Nous avions l'impression de les déranger à chaque demande qui n’était pas honoré. Nous avons dû écourté notre séjour et partir dans un autre hôtel. Une honte !

review_text: Wir haben kürzlich in diesem Hotel übernachtet und leider war unser Aufenthalt weniger zufriedenstellend, insbesondere im Bereich des Frühstücks und des Service. Obwohl wir schon mehrfach hier waren, mussten wir feststellen, dass die Qualität in diesen Bereichen deutlich nachgelassen hat. Das Frühstück war sehr begrenzt und bot kaum Auswahl. Wer Wert auf ein umfangreiches Frühstück legt, könnte hier enttäuscht werden. Darüber hinaus war der Service sehr langsam. Es dauerte oft lange, bis Bestellungen an den Tisch gebracht wurden, und auf Nachfragen wurde nicht immer prompt reagiert. Ein weiterer Punkt, der uns störte, war das wiederholte Hervorheben von kostenpflichtigen Bestellungen. Jedes Mal, wenn wir etwas zusätzlich bestellten, wurden wir gebeten, eine Unterschrift zu leisten, was den Eindruck erweckte, dass mehr Wert auf zusätzliche Einnahmen als auf den Komfort der Gäste gelegt wird.

Hem yaz hem de kış aylarında ayrı ayrı ziyaret ettiğimiz bu güzel otel; konumu, çalışanları ve mutfağıyla bize her defasında eşsiz bir deneyim yaşatıyor. The rooms were on the smaller side but clean and air con was great. They were cleaned daily if you pressed the button to request it. Both pools were well maintained and clean. If you want to get one of the best sunloungers you have to get there by 6.30, but other ones are available during the day. The beach is very busy but the sea is lovely and clean. There are some dogs and cats that wander the beach road and cats at the resort. This was a plus for us! All the animals are very well behaved and dont bother guests. The sea is pebbley at points but fine with the right shoes. The restaurant had a great selection of food. If you are from the UK and expecting all English food you will.be disappointed but if you are looking to try a variety of food it is great. Always fresh salad and a variety of hot dishes different every day. We are vegetarian but there looked to be a good selection of meat and fish. You can sit inside or by the pool or on the roof terrace. We only had one day where we had to wait a minute for a table all week. Staff work very hard to clear tables. Drinks are available at the pool bar and beach bar. There is often a short queue but the friendly staff are wonderful and help as quickly as they can. They serve branded soft drinks, beer and a good selection of cocktails and mocktails. Entertainment wise, there is darts in the morning and then water polo or volley ball in the afternoon. In the evening there was a mini disco for the kids then either outside Entertainment (we saw an acrobatic act and a dance act) or karaoke done by the entertainment team. A big shout out to Berk from the entertainment team- he really made our holiday! He was very kind and always made sure my son felt included and had fun at all the activities. Because of him and the work of all the other great staff a good holiday became truly unforgettable!

review_text: The hotel is located directly on the beach. It is an older resort that has recently undergone a partial renovation. However, the renovation is far from sufficient for a 4-star property. In my opinion, the hotel currently meets the standards of a 3-star hotel at best. Parking is a major issue. There are not enough parking spaces, so guests have to park on nearby local roads. During our stay, we were repeatedly asked by local residents to move our car because it was blocking access to their vehicles. Although the rooms have been recently renovated, the quality of the workmanship is poor and gives the impression that everything was completed in a hurry. The furniture has not been replaced and appears old and worn, especially the beds, which are uncomfortable. Bathroom towels are changed only every two to three days instead of daily, which is disappointing for a hotel of this category. Beach towels are available only for an additional fee, and bed linen is changed every three days. The restaurant offers a very limited selection of food. Dishes are replenished slowly, often leaving serving trays empty and creating the impression that there is not enough food for all guests. It is common to see guests rushing to the buffet when fresh food is brought out. Usually, there is only one or two meat options, with fish being served most frequently, while the remaining dishes are mainly traditional Turkish cuisine. The food itself is tasty, but the variety is limited. The selection of salads and desserts is surprisingly small for a Turkish hotel, although there is a good variety of fresh fruit. The hotel serves a good selection of local alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, including original Coca-Cola products. However, drinks are available only until 11:00 p.m. instead of midnight, which is disappointing. All beverages are served in plastic cups, which significantly reduces the overall experience, especially when drinking beer. There are not enough sunbeds on the beach to accommodate all guests. Many are reserved as early as 6:00 a.m., and by 7:00 a.m. it is almost impossible to find a free one. The beach consists of sand mixed with small pebbles. The sea is clean, clear, and excellent for swimming, but the beach itself would benefit from better maintenance, particularly around the waste bins near the sunbeds. The hotel does not provide free Wi-Fi, and internet access is available only at an additional charge. There is also an unpleasant odor in parts of the hotel grounds, similar to the smell of sludge from a wastewater treatment plant. It appears that treated wastewater may be used for irrigating the gardens and lawns. Overall, I believe the price we paid was far too high for the level of service and facilities provided. The hotel does not meet the expectations of a 4-star property, and the overall value for money is poor.

review_text: This hotel is NOT 4 star! I have stayed in cleaner and better 3 star hotels. This is very misleading. We stayed for 10 nights with our 21 month old son Pros: sunbeds around the pool were never a problem to get, the waffles with chocolate sauce were nice and the burgers from the snack bar were too, the water slides were great for the kids Cons: bar ran out of vodka gin and most other alcohol on 5 occasions during the 10 days we were there, how can that happen at an all inclusive resort?? Rooms are tired and not very clean, mouldy bathroom and shower, bins not emptied every day and 1 thin sheet between 2 people that didn’t even cover our toes! However when speaking to reception they did provide extra blankets. Food not always hot, be prepared to get your elbows out otherwise you are shoved out the way by Russian guests at the buffet, there is never anything left at breakfast beyond 8am as most other guests pile their plates high and it isn’t replenished, beach overcrowded with sunbeds so people laying and sat right next to you, the stray cats and dogs didn’t bother us but the security guard one evening was aggressively lifting up chairs in the bar and banging them on the floor in front of them and guests to try and get them to leave- not pleasant to see and upsetting to my son. Stairs crumbling away, high chairs weren’t cleaned properly between use and hardly any of the staff smile or interact with you, however they did interact with my son and try to pick him up which subsequently just upset him more as most babies are wary of strangers, maybe some of them needed to interact from a distance as he became quite distressed being grabbed and hugged when he was crying. I would not return here, I have complained to TUI but someone seriously needs to come and inspect this hotel and is it is falling way below 4 star standard. Fawlty towers springs to mind- every guest we spoke to said the same.

Definitely not a 4 star hotel, more like 3 - 3.5.

review_text: Now. We read a lot of the reviews and they were very mixed but here is everything you need to know. We stayed for 7 nights for £550 pp all inclusive through TUI. Firstly when we booked I’m 90% sure it said free WiFi however upon getting there we found out it was €1/$1 a day per person. So we ended up paying €14. Honestly not the end of the world however when we got to the room we discovered it didn’t work in the room and only really worked by the pool. They also charged for a lockbox and €1 if you wanted your towels changed but we found it this wasn’t essential as you could simply take them from the trolly in the hall that was always left there. The hotel and rooms themselves were outdated but by no means dirty. You can tell it hasn’t had work in a while and there was a few broken things like our toilet door didn’t lock but this didn’t really bother us. We had air con for free that worked really well, a kettle and fridge. I will say next to the bed there was only a socket on one side so bear that in mind but as well other rooms might be different I couldn’t say. The drink options you had were wine, beer, vodka, rum and a few others including loads of soft drinks and they would do cocktails free if you asked. The staff I couldn’t fault at all they were all really lovely but a lot did struggle with English so google translate did come out a lot but that’s ok. By the pool there was darts and also water polo everyday including music from 9-5 I think. Now the food. I’m a bit of a picky eater but nothing too bad and I really struggled. The kids counter consisted of chips and veg everyday. There was never chicken nuggets or anything simple in the restaurant it was all a lot of salad, fish and chicken with occasionally some form of pasta. The desert section was really good however and had plenty of options. At lunch you could get burgers from the pool bar and they often had chips and chicken nuggets etc. there’s a shop next door that was fairly cheap if you wanted snacks or anything else. On the listing it says pool and ping pong tables which there are upstairs on the restaurant however no one seems to know how to get the balls and cues etc and your not allowed to play during food service. The location was beautiful on a street with lots of restaurants, bars and some shops which was really nice to venture out to. All in all for what we paid it was a really good holiday however I would just take it into account the few downsides. End of the day for what we paid I can’t really complain more than anything it was the additional costs that make this not as good for me.

review_text: The worst hotel we've ever stayed in in Turkey. We drove the entire Turkish coast from Mersin to Izmir. And we had to "check off" Bodrum as well. We decided to stay at this hotel and paid 41,000 rubles for one night (which is a decent amount for Turkey, but apparently not for Bodrum). The hotel is not 5* at all. Food is a 3-star, service is a 4-star. The food is simply really bad! It feels like you're in a 3-star hotel! You have a choice for dinner: either overcooked meat or overcooked meat, and to avoid any problems, you end up choosing the overcooked grilled fish... Mashed potatoes with peppers. There are no simple, understandable dishes. Some kind of stew and a mishmash of chicken and vegetables. You could overlook all this, but the food is truly terrible. You literally can't put together even one dish for dinner. I'm not even talking about seafood. There was nothing like that here. We ate peaches. Patisserie is desserts from the cafeteria... the ice cream is decent. We didn't have time for lunch, so we tried the snack bar. It was very bad food... spicy, overdried chicken. Or shawarma. The only thing that's okay is pizza. From 5 to 6 pm is "BBQ time." What do you expect from a 5-star hotel? Well, for example, grilled fish or meat. No, it's a Turkish burger, just one. That's all. Breakfasts are acceptable, they have what you need, but nothing fancy. Beach. There's no beach as such, just sun loungers on the pier and on the grass above the pier, but finding them is a hassle. Vacationers throw down their towels and leave, and no one keeps an eye on them. Entrance to the sea is convenient from the pier. The sea is a murky puddle, like swimming in a lake in the Leningrad region. We love snorkeling; there are lots of fish, but you can't really see them through the murky water. And I always wondered who these people were, coming to this hotel specifically for their one and only vacation. Sure, we were just passing through and made a mistake with the hotel—it happens, but why come here for your entire vacation when, for the same money, in Kemer, for example, you could get a super hotel with excellent food and pristine sea and nature? Hot? Then Ölüdeniz. But why Bodrum? As far as I understand, 40,000 a night (what we paid, not including flights!) is very low for Bodrum, and for that price, "thank you for the bed" is a welcome surprise 😄 but we didn't know that. We could have stayed at a small boutique hotel with breakfast in the city center and then visited different beaches. But if you want all-inclusive, choose a significantly more expensive hotel. Customer: Mostly Turkish. Everything's fine, but! Their smoking culture is outrageous. So, coming to the beach, dragging a sun lounger right up to it, and starting smoking nonstop is par for the course. It's disgusting and unpleasant, and we had to leave. There aren't many Russians, but there are some. I'd like to say the best thing about this hotel is the rooms, BUT: —our shower wouldn't drain. You wash for one minute, then wait for three! review_text: Beautiful location, only 30 minutes from the airport. Staff were friendly throughout — funnily enough they got noticeably nicer after the first week, like they'd been sent on a customer service refresher mid-stay. Sun beds were never really an issue; plenty available if you were down by 9am. Restaurant seating was always easy to find too, no scrapping for tables. The Kids Club was the highlight for us — genuinely excellent. Our daughter didn't need any persuading; she was raring to go every single morning. We'd also strongly recommend the Brothers boat trip, run by the guys at Duja — a brilliant trip, and they were genuinely pleasant, still greeting us and having a chat every time we crossed paths for the rest of the holiday. A special mention for our Jet2 rep, Hakan — we ran into a few issues during the stay and he was fantastic at sorting them out for us. A few things let it down. The food was repetitive and, frankly, a bit boring — the same rotation day after day, and it would have gone a long way to have a themed night or two to break it up. The daytime pool and mini disco music didn't change once in two weeks, which got old fast. The à la carte experience, which is talked up as something special, really wasn't — didn't feel any different to the main buffet in quality. And the hotel itself is showing its age; it needs some general refurbishment and TLC. Some floors in the main hotel also have shared terraces with only a limited sea view, worth checking before you book. Overall: great spot, brilliant kids' facilities, a top boat trip and a rep who had our back, but the food, entertainment, and upkeep need investment to match the location.

review_text: We’ve just come back from a 2 weeks stay at Duja Bodrum and overall we had a really great holiday. We’d definitely go back. The transfer from the airport only took about 25mins. The food was one of the things we really enjoyed. There was loads of choice and the snack bars were particularly good, with different pasta dishes, chicken wraps, burgers, pizzas, waffles etc. Breakfast was also really good, with omelettes made to order as well as lots of other options. There was always food being cooked fresh outside at tea time as well as the buffet, which was great. We tried the Asian and fish à la carte restaurants and both were really nice. The food was lovely and the service was great. One thing we really liked was that there are freezers with ice creams dotted around the hotel, as well as fridges full of bottled water, so you can just help yourself whenever you want. The lifeguards were also really on the ball around the pools, which was reassuring. The ladies in the kids’ club were lovely. We personally never left our children there on their own and always stayed with them, but from what we saw they were fantastic with all the children and really looked after them. Selin & Nehir deserves a special mention, our boys loved them. The boys are wild and they were amazing with them. Customer service throughout the hotel was probably one of the biggest positives. Everyone was really friendly and helpful and they genuinely couldn’t do enough for you. Our room was clean and spacious and the maid did a really good job. The mini bar was also restocked every day, which was a nice bonus. If I had one criticism, it would be that I’d have liked a few more evening shows. They had shows about four nights a week, and on the other nights there was a film for the kids, bingo or a night off. The shows they did have were really good and the mini disco was on every night, so there was still plenty going on, but more evening entertainment would have been nice. They do also have live music at the pool bar each night. Overall, we really enjoyed our stay. There’s a great choice of food, the staff are lovely, the hotel is well looked after and there’s plenty for families. We had a brilliant holiday and would definitely return to Duja Bodrum.

review_text: We recently stayed at Duja Bodrum and unfortunately our experience was very mixed. While there were some excellent aspects of the holiday, there were several areas that fell well below what we would expect from a 5-star hotel. The biggest disappointment was the food. We booked an à la carte restaurant under the impression that we would be able to choose from five different restaurants. However, when it came to booking, we were only offered a choice between the Turkish or Fish restaurant. Neither appealed to us, but we opted for the Turkish restaurant. The food arrived cold, the presentation was poor, and it felt like very little care had gone into the dining experience. The main restaurant was also disappointing and certainly not the “amazing” dining experience described in many reviews. We are not fussy eaters by any means, but there were several evenings where the only things that looked appetising were chicken nuggets, chips, salad and dessert. The food seemed to be catered more towards German and Russian guests, with surprisingly few authentic Turkish dishes available. If there had been restaurants within walking distance of the hotel, we would have chosen to eat elsewhere on several occasions. The snack bars at lunchtime were much better. A lot of the food appeared to be frozen products, but it was generally edible and some items were genuinely enjoyable. Service in the main restaurant was another let-down. Staff always seemed attentive to guests of other nationalities, whereas as English guests we often struggled to get service. On more than one occasion we had nearly finished our meal before anyone came to take a drinks order. On a positive note, the entertainment team were outstanding. They were always friendly, welcoming and enthusiastic, and genuinely couldn’t do enough for guests. The reception team were also polite and helpful throughout our stay. In fact, the majority of the staff were excellent and always willing to help. We really couldn’t fault their attitude. If you tip them, be prepared to have drinks arriving constantly! The accommodation was another major disappointment. Our room felt very tired and nowhere near the standard expected of a 5-star hotel. There were large cracks in the bathroom tiles, peeling paint on the ceiling from what appeared to be a previous leak, stained bedroom furnishings, wallpaper that was peeling away with mould and dirty marks visible, and bed sheets with holes and stains. review_text: Duja is a truly massive resort with expansive grounds, offering plenty of space to explore and enjoy. When we first arrived, it made a fantastic impression — the setting is beautiful, and during the early part of our stay, it felt relaxed and well-balanced. There were plenty of sun loungers available, with lots of quiet spots to unwind and soak up the sun. However, as the week went on, the experience began to shift. The hotel became noticeably more crowded, and it unfortunately felt as though the resort wasn’t quite equipped to handle the influx of guests. Finding a comfortable area to relax became much more difficult, and the restaurant in particular suffered — lunch and dinner times were consistently overcrowded and far from enjoyable. The rooms and facilities, while functional, are starting to show their age and would benefit from some refurbishment and modernisation. A bit of TLC would go a long way in elevating the overall experience. To top it off, we had the misfortune of being next to a very loud neighbour who partied on their balcony until well past midnight, which took away from the otherwise relaxing atmosphere we were hoping for. Overall, Duja has great potential thanks to its size and location, but it currently struggles during busier periods and would benefit from some updates and better crowd management.

review_text: Overall the holiday was enjoyable we had a good time, just some things could have been better. We travelled as 6 adults and one 2 year old. We arrived at about 1.30 am after a 2 hour delay and no food and only tea , coffee and water on our flight. We were disappointed to find there was no food available on our arrival. The staff are what make this hotel, they are so willing to help and can’t do enough. We had my grandson with us , it was both his and my birthday while we were here. We booked the Italian à la carte , which was nice ( apart from the chicken) and the staff presented us with a cake each. They sang Happy Birthday and made a fuss of him, as all the staff did every day. He especially loved the girl in the restaurant Meryem who always played with him and made him laugh. Positives- The place is very clean, beautiful gardens , fabulous staff, especially in Raay bar.amazing views, entertainment that we saw was very good. Mini disco for the kids was great. Where improvements could be made- - why isn’t there any ice cream or lollies in the freezers? , we were there a week and they were always empty! Never in an all inclusive have we experienced this? It is available at 3 pm near the snack bar but the queue is always huge, with just one person serving. There was no toaster! Sometimes for breakfast all you want is a slice of toast. There was ONE sandwich grill , again always a queue with people making multiple toasties for the rest of the family. Don’t go for dinner at 7 when it opens unless you fancy a game of ‘ It’s a Knockout’ absolute carnage with people pushing in and being greedy taking far too much for the rest of their table, I saw a couple of altercations almost coming to blows’ The food was ok, again no ice cream available for dessert, which is strange. Our flight home was an evening flight 11.40 and considering we didn’t arrive until the early hours of the following day thought we may keep our room until at least teatime . My daughter was 7 months pregnant with a 2 year old and really needed somewhere to rest until at least an hour or so before we were due to be picked up. We were told there were NO rooms at all that we could use , until we said we would pay then miraculously one was available. Would I come here again? Probably not, we all said we have been to better All Inclusives. Maybe if the changes I pointed out were made we would reconsider. As I said all in all we had a good time, Thankyou everyone, you all work very hard and it was very much appreciated.

review_text: We recently returned from a week-long holiday with a group of 4 adults and 5 children (ages 10-13). This hotel has plenty of potential, but a major security issue and subpar standards mean it does not deserve its 5-star rating. The Good Points: *Pools & Beach: The main pool is large, the indoor pool was great during poor weather, and the beach is very nice. There were always plenty of sunbeds available. *Staff: The team was generally friendly, though we frequently had to use Google Translate as very few spoke English. *Room Resolution: When we pointed out that our third room was smelly and unkept, the staff accommodated us and moved us near our other two clean, spacious rooms. The Bad Points: *Late Arrival: Arriving at 23:30, the restaurant was shut and no arrival buffet was set up. We had to ask multiple times just to get basic sandwiches.Room *Maintenance: In our moving room, the air conditioning and television did not work at all in any of our rooms. We also had no Wi-Fi in our rooms for the first few days, which was rectified after complaining everyday. *Mobility Warning: The hotel is massive and dotted with steps everywhere. Avoid this property if you have mobility struggles. *Crowd Management: Meal times are incredibly chaotic, and the staff clearly struggle to manage the volume of guests. *The Major Concern (Data Protection Breach):At check-in, we provided names and phone numbers for the adults in each room. The next morning, every single number received a text from a local tour company claiming to be our official holiday reps. They sold us trips that we later had to cancel and refund. Our holiday provider confirmed they have no reps in Turkey. When we confronted the hotel about leaking our data, they denied it and blamed our private airport transfer. However, we caught them out: one adult had accidentally written a child’s name next to their phone number on the hotel check-in card. The tour company addressed that adult by the child's name, proving without a doubt that the leak came directly from the hotel front desk. The hotel still refuses to take responsibility for what is a serious breach of privacy and a potential police matter. Without this security issue, we would have rated this a 3-star hotel. Because of it, we cannot recommend this place to anyone and will not be back.

review_text: Wow Duja Bodrum is a wonderful Resort. Friendly helpful staff, great facilities and beautiful views. Our family of 12 includes 3 generations & we are currently spenting a week here and having a great time. We emailed in in advance and asked for specific rooms together. The hotel said they would try but did not promise and we did not get our hopes up but we were delighted to arrive and find they have been able to give us exactly what we asked for. We are loving the variety of pools available including the small almost private pool in our club area. Our older child and young adults love the waterside pool, which is very near the club area. The younger children are enjoying the kids club. The indoor pool is good when we need to give the children a break from the sun. Several of our family has massages(extra cost) they gave us very good reports. We used our 1 night a la carte to eat at the Italian restaurant and it made a nice change. Lots of reviews mentioned mosquitos,so we brought lots of products but were not using them as no mosquitos at first but later in the week some of us did get bitten by something. There is a bit of walking between club area & main building but we find it is good exercise and the golf buggies are always parked at the door near reception and the guys there were willing to drive us if we asked. There is a very handy what's app number that one can message during one's stay to ask questions about the resort. All the mom's got a flower and beautiful letter on Mother's day. The hotel wifi was very helpful, especially because we were outside eu roaming. No coverage in some areas but it .Just be challenging to 100% cover such a large area. As our week progressed the resort got more and more busy, the crowds made our stay less pleasant but overall its 5 stars for Duja Bodrum. Thank you all for our great holiday

There are daily entertainment activities for children, and in the evenings adults can enjoy quizzes, concerts, and other fun programs. The hotel also has a SPA center. I had a medical massage there, and the massage therapist HACER is a true professional. I highly recommend her. There is also a leather shop in the hotel called LojaMax. The seller Arif was extremely helpful, explained everything clearly, and organized transportation to and from the store. There is absolutely no reason to be afraid to visit — the shop staff are very kind and welcoming. We truly enjoyed our stay and will definitely return to this hotel again!

review_text: Review as a couple visiting in September. Firstly, the views are amazing. The location of the hotel is easy via taxi from the airport, and the scenery is stunning as it is situated on a hillside. Pros: - no subbed wars (maybe due to end of season) but as there are spaces along the pier, beach, promenade and up at the pool there are loads of sunbeds around, even when arriving later in the morning. - Starbucks is a really nice touch, it is simple (lattes and refresher drinks) but adds a little bit of home for those who enjoy it. - the hotel is very clean, there are always cleaners on hand, clean tables and the rooms were spotless. - the village room I would recommend! We were in the middle of the village, and didn’t hear too much, however I can see that if you are unfortunate and get a room further away it’s a longer walk to the hotel, or too close and the music would keep you awake if you wanted an early night. - the sea! Wow wow wow!! There are safe spaces to swim, and if you are confident I’d recommend going SUP in the early morning. Bring snorkels or goggles are there are lots of fish to look at when swimming. Cons: - the food. If you are a foodie (of which we are) we struggled. Very repetitive, same starters and desserts every day. Very stew heavy and a lot of beige. After 10 days we’re very bored of the same thing each time. The A La Carte restaurant (Chinese, Italian or Fish) were very nice and much more what we expected for what we paid - this just was a disappointment for our trip. - dinner service was busy, if you can go later in the evening I’d reccomend you do. At 7pm and only one dinner restaurant there were long queues to wait, limited tables and slow to get drinks from staff. - the branded drinks are only served in once place … why?? At all the bars you can get drinks (cocktails are always good) but the branded spirits are only served in the lobby bar, which limited seating (but amazing views) it was a shame as we felt we had to battle for seats to enjoy a nicer drink. - music on repeat - all the time. We love some music while chilling by the pool, but the same playlist is used everyday, there are only so many times we could listen to Ellie Goulding and Coldplay before you get bored. There are a few quiet spaces but not many, go further down the beach to get away from the music. Overall, we had a lovely time and adapted to what we wanted to make the most of what we paid for.

Wow wow wow!! There are safe spaces to swim, and if you are confident I’d recommend going SUP in the early morning. Bring snorkels or goggles are there are lots of fish to look at when swimming. Cons: - the food. If you are a foodie (of which we are) we struggled. Very repetitive, same starters and desserts every day. Very stew heavy and a lot of beige. After 10 days we’re very bored of the same thing each time. The A La Carte restaurant (Chinese, Italian or Fish) were very nice and much more what we expected for what we paid - this just was a disappointment for our trip. - dinner service was busy, if you can go later in the evening I’d reccomend you do. At 7pm and only one dinner restaurant there were long queues to wait, limited tables and slow to get drinks from staff. - the branded drinks are only served in once place ... why?? At all the bars you can get drinks (cocktails are always good) but the branded spirits are only served in the lobby bar, which limited seating (but amazing views) it was a shame as we felt we had to battle for seats to enjoy a nicer drink. - music on repeat - all the time. We love some music while chilling by the pool, but the same playlist is used everyday, there are only so many times we could listen to Ellie Goulding and Coldplay before you get bored. There are a few quiet spaces but not many, go further down the beach to get away from the music. Overall, we had a lovely time and adapted to what we wanted to make the most of what we paid for.

review_text: We recently stayed at Duja Bodrum and overall had a great experience. The hotel is kept very clean, and there are plenty of hardworking staff who are always friendly and helpful. The food was very good with lots of variety, and the à la carte restaurant was definitely the highlight meal of the week. The kids really enjoyed the children’s pool and water slides, and the afternoon snack bars were a nice touch. It’s also handy that the hotel offers a midnight meal, which is great if you arrive late or get hungry after hours. Our room was spacious and comfortable too. The beachfront is lovely and relaxing — during our stay, the public beach just to the right of the hotel was completely empty, which made the setting even better. A few things to be aware of: the resort is large and spread out across different levels, so you’ll often need to use stairs or lifts to get around. The snack bar by the slide pool was closed all week during our stay, and the slides only opened for a few hours each day — this may have been due to it being a quieter period. There’s also about a 5-minute walk between the slides and the kids’ pool, which could be tricky with younger children. Around the pool and resort, be prepared to be approached fairly often by the brothers selling boat trips, as well as the hotel photographers. One other point is transport into Bodrum. Reception directed us towards a taxi service charging €60, but we later found out there’s a bus just outside the hotel that only costs €3 return — a much better option for guests to know about! Despite these minor drawbacks, we had a very enjoyable stay. The staff really do make the difference, and we’d happily recommend Duja Bodrum and would return in the future.

review_text: В этом отеле 2 хорошие вещи: вид и бармены (в частности бармен Рамазан, очень приятный человек и професснионал своего дела). Отель ну очень маленький, номера старые, уборка работает тяп ляп, даже если оставляешь хорошие чаевые. Персонал в ресторане вообще отдельная тема. Мы отдыхали с сестрой и в первый день нас вообще не хотели обслуживать, мы просто сидели и ждали по полчаса, пока местных обслуживали с улыбкой. (В первую неделю поездки здесь отдыхали в основном местные). На второй день один из главных официантов резко начал быть вежливым, предложил тарелку фруктов за ужином, клубнику в вино (мы понадеялись, что хоть кто-то здесь хорошо относится к русским, но как бы не так) в конце ужина он начал зазывать нас в какой-то паб...а через 2 дня МЕНЕДЖЕР ресторана Фират (который так же все то время игнорировал нас и уперто отвечал нам на турецком, когда мы просили разговаривать на английском) за одним ужином сказал, что сегодня мы его особые гости, сам нас обслуживал, был вежливым, в конце попросил инстаграм моей сестры и вечером написывал с вопросами куда мы ушли (а время на минуточку было уже 22.30). На следующий вечер мы пропустили ужин из-за экскурсии и сидели в баре, он начал опять настойчиво проявлять к нам внимание, а потом написал моей сестре с предложениями посмотреть с ним какой-то "секрет на пляже"...что он там собирался показывать можно догадаться. Мы рассказали об этих моментах на рецепшен, тк для нас это НЕ НОРМА, даже просто подобные предложения от персонала. Нам сказали, что нас будет обслуживать девушка в ресторане, чего естественно не произошло (ну и ладно, главное те мужчины нас с тех пор избегали). Потом Фират подошёл к нам с "извинениями", сказал, что они "просто развлекались" и "не нужно было жаловаться". Нам не хочется знать что было бы, если бы мы не пожаловались... Еще нам испортили вещи, которые мы отдали на стирку. Ну как можно было додуматься постирать СИНИЙ купальник с БЕЛЫМИ вещами. Ну слава богу с нас не взяли денег за стирку. Еще хочется отметить, что девушка на рецепшен вообще НИКАК по английски не говорила...только по турецки, пришлось общаться переводчиком. В отеле кроме крохотного рецепшена, который предназначен только для одного/двух сотрудников и номера, нет НИ ОДНОГО места с кондиционером. У нас был тур 9 дней и 10 ночей, трансфер в аэропорт был в 18, а выселили нас почему-то в 12.00, когда по сути ночь еще оплачена. Ну и 6 часов надо торчать где-то под палящим солнцем...а еще и вся еда и напитки становятся платными!!! Либо плати 75 евро!!!!!за человека и заказывай что хочешь, либо каждое блюдо платно (например листья салата и маленький кусочек курицы с ними 7,5 евро). Также в отеле нет ни guest relation, ни СПАСАТЕЛЯ на скалистом пляже. В общем ожидания не оправдались, отель НЕ ГОТОВ к принятию иностранных туристов как минимум, как максимум не стоит своих денег.

review_text: Wir waren eine Woche im Hotel. Lage ist nicht unbedingt gut, außer man will nur im Hotel bleiben. Man kann nichts kaufen, weil der angebliche Markt im Hotel seit Jahren nicht mehr existiert. Wir mussten ein Taxi in den nächsten Ort für 18 E nehmen um Zigaretten zu kaufen. Das Hotel ist am Berg gebaut. Der Weg von täglich einfach über 150 Stufen zum Meer. Das Meer ist sehr stürmisch, ab mittag kann man nicht mehr richtig ins Wasser- über die Leitern, weil es einen sonst gegen die Steine haut. Man muss schon sehr gut schwimmen können. Das Essen ist furchtbar, man findet zwar was, aber immer das selbe und das warme essen ist immer kalt. Auswahl..... ich bin war anderes von sogar 3 Sternen Hotels in der Türkei gewöhnt. Fliege seit über 35 Jahren in die Türkei, aber so ein schlechtes Essen und Service , habe ich noch nie erlebt. Die Kellner sind muffelig und haben keinen Anstand. Nur eine Kellnerin und zwei Kellner waren sehr freundlich. Die Reinigung in den Zimmern war übelste Art. Die Dame, hat nie gewischt, in einer Woche. Gerade das Sie das Bett gemacht hat, war alles. Nicht einmal die benützten Tassen und Gläser hat Sie weggeräumt. Klopapier und Kaffee wurden nicht aufgefüllt. Das Bett geradeso hingelegt. Wasser lief aus dem Waschbecken, im Bad stand das Wasser 2 Tage lang. Toilette nicht geputzt. So was haben wir noch nie erlebt. Das erste mal, in 35 Jahren, wo eine Reinigungskraft so ungründlich geputzt hat. Wir hatten eine der besten Suits und dann so was. Die Woche kostete uns ein Haufen Geld, für einen üblen Service. das Hotel liegt genau an der Straße nach Bodrum. Man kann nicht direkt nach Bodrum mit einem Dolmus fahren. Sondern erst nach Torga. Von dort umsteigen nach Bodrum. Oder man nimmt sich gleich ein Taxi- Hinfahrt 10 E . Rückfahrt ca. 16 €. Auch kann man keine Ausflüge im Hotel buchen, man muss wieder nach Bodrum fahren. Flair im Hotel ist super. Rezeption waren die Angestellten sehr nett. Im Hotel spricht keiner Deutsch, nur Türkisch und Englisch. Sehr viel Türkische Gäste, die bevorzugt behandelt werden. Das Essen ist mehr auf die türkischen Gäste eingestellt. Die einen wirklich nerven können, weil Sie ständig laut neben einem telefonieren und mit dem Handy ,Fernseh schauen, ob beim Essen oder am Strand. In der Woche hat es jeden Abend an der Poolbar am Abend Liveübertragung von Fußball gegeben. (Sehr Laut)!!!!! Das hat nichts mit Urlaub zu tun, wenn ich mir mit einheimischen das Fußballspiel anhören muss. Anstatt in Ruhe an der bar etwas trinken möchte. Wir sind dann jeden Tag ab dem Abendessen auf das Zimmer. Toll....... Das Essen Mittag an der Sunset Bar, übelste Art. Ich wollte einfach anstatt dem Salat, der übrigens ohne Dressing gebracht wird, ein paar Gurken und Tomaten. Das hat man uns verwährt. So war machen sie nicht. Das Lahmacun würde auf einen Holzbrett gebracht, wir sahen wie der Kellner das Brett einfach mit einem schmutzigen Lappen, mit dem er vorher die schmutzigen Tische gereinigt hatte-

review_text: Здравствуйте! Отзыв для тех кто хочет узнать про этот отель во всех красках! Отель довольно не плохой (море, вид с номера, дизайн не обычный, людей не так много, много зелени, хорошая локация). Но сервис просто ужас за вами следит весь персонал прямь реально следят! Не хотелось бы писать плохой отзыв но приходится это делать. Сервис это отдельная история, на встречу к вам не идут есть внутренние правила которые ни где не описаны, отель позиционирует себя как лакшери но они считают сколько ты выпил алкоголя, съел еды в ресторане это как минимум странно! Бары работают по времени как захотели они! Указано например до 6 вечера но на самом деле закрываются раньше времени! Говорят что напитки все закончились и идите в другой бар, но дела в том что баров всего два! К стате в номере не работал кондиционер и холодильник, мини бар не был заполнен, я думал что это только в моем номере, но нет то же самое было в номере моих друзей. Конечно не советую этот отель если вы привыкли к хорошим условиям!

review_text: Fiyat performansta sınıfta jalan bir konuklama Öncelikle ilk girişte bir gün önce kontrol ettirmeme rağmen hotel comdan yaptığım rezervasyonu bulamadılar. Tek oda kaldı denmesine rağmen otel boştu ve bizi denizi gören üst kat bir odaya alabilecek iken her zaman yapıldığı gibi manzarası daha sınırlı olan bir odaya alındık. Restaurantta klima çalışmadığından ilk gece deniz manzarasından uzak bir masa da klima altında olmak için oturduk. Aynı durum sabah kahvaltıda da devam edince şef ahçıya sorunca bende çalışanım burda klimalar bozuk diye kestirip attı. Yetkili kişiyi istedim. O da genel müdürü çağırdı. İşte o andan itibaren tatil daha iyi bir seviyeye geldi. Çünkü Muarrem bey bu sorunla uğraştığını ve çözmek için elinden geleni yaptığını ve özürlerini ileterek bir genel müdürün otel misafirinin sorunları ile nasıl maksimum ilgilenebileceğini gösterdi. Kendisi aldığı sorumluluğun farkında olan gerçek bir profesyonel. Daha sonra bizi de plajda kaldığımız sürece kabanada ayarladı. Ancak otel eski ve yenilenmesi gereken yerleri var. Yiyecek kısmı aldığı konaklama ücretlerine ters oranda çok zayıftı. Yemek çeşitleri ve kalitesi nerede ise bir devlet kampı düzeyinde idi. Etten tasarruf etmek için mönüyü en ekonomik şekilde dizayn etmeleri tatilde en çok misafirlerce istenilen yeme içme keyfini eksik bıraktı ve sadece karın doyurmak için yenilen bir yemekten ileri geçilemedi. Sonuçta manzarası ve konumu güzel olan otelin yeme içme ve konaklama konforu olarak fiyat performans dengesizliği mevcut. Ama en olumlu yanı genel müdürü.

review_text: The Susona Bodrum resort is an excellent location for a destination wedding & visit to nearby Bodrum city & harbor. The bride chose one of the Susona's docks into the bay of the Aegean for the ceremony's location, and one of several indoor/outdoor large meeting spaces for the preliminary reception & post-ceremony dinner. All these spaces were large enough for up to ~150 guests. The service from the staff was excellent, particularly when one of Bodrum's frequent passing evening showers came by shortly after the wedding ceremony had concluded. The helpful staff quickly deployed umbrellas & towels to get everyone under cover and to get all the seats dried out after the shower passed. The staff was always helpful during our entire stay @ Susona, even with so many wedding guests trying to arrange things at last minute. The food @ Susona was very good, both during the wedding & during the daily breakfast service. The pool waitstaff was equally good; bringing us custom orders poolside and to the small seating area. There are two conventional pools (both with reasonably warm water, even in mid-May) and you can swim in the Aegean if you like (you're on your own with the ocean water temperature). Our rooms are very nice; with the size & comfort you'd expect in a destination resort. Note the building holding the rooms are some distance from the main lobby, breakfast & pool area. You'll have to walk to these, or call for one of the golf/utility carts to come to pick you (and your luggage) up. Private cars won't be allowed near the room past the main parking area. My room towards the back was very quiet while I was there, although during the wedding party we were the ones making all the noise. Occasionally you'll hear one of the many resident cats meow in anticipation of another food treat; give them any and you'll have a companion for the remainder of your stay. Susona is pretty isolated from the rest of its neighbors; they assume you'll be spending much of your time on site. There's nothing really to walk to nearby. A taxi ride to downtown Bodrum is ~$15 each way. I'd recommend this for a destination event, such as a wedding, or you want to get away for any downtown hustle.

review_text: I expected much more from an LXR property, especially as a Hilton Diamond member. Unfortunately, too many details were missed throughout the stay, starting with check-in: there was no welcome drink, no welcome amenities in the room, and no personal welcome or letter from the GM. We also had an ongoing issue with the TV, which repeatedly turned off, and even after Engineering attended, the problem continued. There was also a surprising lack of attention to detail from housekeeping, who consistently provided only one loofah despite the room being occupied by two guests. The bathtub was beautiful, but there were no bath salts or any special bath amenities to actually enjoy it. Breakfast was another disappointment: the restaurant itself is beautiful and creates very high expectations, but the buffet selection was extremely limited and small. Overall, the property is beautiful, but the service, attention to detail, and guest recognition did not feel at the level I would expect from an LXR hotel.
