review_text: Susona was great, but the people made it amazing. We stayed in Villa 41 for 4 days at the end of our 11 day Türkiye trip and it was the prefect way to unwind and relax. The villa was spacious and the views were amazing. The breakfast buffet was a perfect way to start each day and the onsite restaurants were a great way to end the day. For a family of 6 we averaged $400 per dinner which isn't that bad considering we were at a high end resort. Swimming in the Aegean was nice and cool during the hot days...but be mindful, this resort is on a rocky peninsula so they don't have a sandy beach. All swimming was done off of large wooden jetties/docks that were built over the rocky coastline. It surprised us at first, but after day one we didn't care. Now let me tell you about the staff. They were absolutely great. They did everything to make sure our stay was exactly as we wanted it. Chef Mehmet cooked us an amazing backyard BBQ at our villa. Night Manager Bugra made sure we were well accommodated the whole time and even helped us get time on the small turf soccer field at the adjacent hotel. Yusuf and a different Bugra were always there when I had a question or needed help with something. And last but not least, Irem catered to our every need. She would hold a table for us every morning for breakfast, help us with food selections, made sure my vegetarian daughter was taken care of and worked with Chef Mehmet to make sure our backyard BBQ was perfect. She was so good to us. On the last morning she gave us a really sweet note that she stayed up late writing with Google translate. I only name 5 here, but there were many more who really made us feel at home. I will say it again, Susona was great, but the people made it amazing.

review_text: I stayed at Rammos Hotel in Bodrum and honestly I can’t recommend it enough. I booked it because I needed a quiet break to decompress and relax. As it wasn’t really the season yet, I expected things to be limited because of the weather. But wow, they completely exceeded my expectations. From the moment I arrived, the staff made me feel so welcomed, they greeted me with flowers and a traditional drink for their 4th anniversary, which instantly set the tone for the stay. I was travelling solo so I was a bit nervous, but every member of staff made me feel so comfortable and cared for that it genuinely felt like I had my own little community there. I even stayed at another hotel afterwards and instantly missed Rammos because the hospitality and care were unmatched. Because there were only a few guests staying, it made the experience even more special. Seeing the same familiar faces every day made it feel like home in the best way. It honestly felt euphoric, completely detached from busy everyday life and like stepping into another world where everything slows down and people genuinely want you to relax and enjoy yourself. Seyda, Marvin, Burak and all the staff were amazing (sorry if I missed names). We shared many heartwarming moments that I’ll always remember. One of the biggest highlights was the spa. Malik and Pho were incredible and paid so much attention to my needs. I had hammam treatments, sauna sessions, facials, herbal teas and some of the best massages I’ve ever had. They even assessed my body, explained my tension and gave advice on how to improve it properly. You can tell they genuinely care about healing and wellness. Because it was off-season there wasn’t a breakfast buffet, but honestly I loved the personalised experience even more. Every morning they asked what I wanted and somehow brought sooo much food with endless options. I left breakfast full every single day. The hotel itself is beautiful. So aesthetic, peaceful and healing! Every corner felt calming and luxurious without being overwhelming. Also massive appreciation for the Marea restaurant and Tarik, who was so kind and attentive. He recommended an amazing dish and even helped remove the fish scales for me without hesitation. Such a thoughtful gesture that really reflected the hospitality throughout the whole hotel. Overall, this trip gave me exactly what I needed and more. I arrived stressed and exhausted and left feeling lighter, relaxed and genuinely happy. Even though it wasn’t peak season, the experience still felt luxurious, personal and unforgettable. I would 100% recommend Rammos Hotel to anyone wanting a peaceful getaway in Bodrum. I can’t wait to come back. Thank you so much to the whole Rammos team!!

review_text: I recently stayed at this hotel in Bodrum, Turkbuku, an area I’m very familiar with. The overall design of the hotel is quite eye-catching, and the rooms were spacious, nicely decorated, and appeared clean. However, I had a few issues during my stay. First, the bedding: there was only one twin blanket provided on a queen-sized bed, which was uncomfortable for two people. Additionally, the room lacked basic amenities such as a coffee machine, water, or a kettle with complimentary drinks—something I would expect for early mornings or late nights spent in the room. Breakfast was decent, nothing spectacular, but not bad either. The beach area was a nice touch, and I appreciated the hotel providing towels for the beach. The Turkish coffee was great, but I ordered an iced latte, and unfortunately, there were coffee kernels in it, and the espresso itself wasn’t to our taste. Otele yaklaşırken park ve valiz taşınması için resepsiyonu tam 7 kez aramama rağmen hiçbir şekilde telefonlarıma cevap verilmedi ve valizlerim taşınmadı. Tavuk burger sipariş ettim, tavuk pişmemişti. Kahvaltıda ise bayat ürünler sunuluyordu. Otele geldiğimden beri mide problemleri yaşadım ve bir kez kustum. Sabah erken saatte kalkıp kendime yer ayırdım, kahvaltıya gidip döndüğümde ise yerime başkalarını almışlardı ve bu kişileri kaldırmayacaklarını söylediler. Bu durumun torpille alakalı olabileceğini düşünüyorum. Tüm bu yaşadıklarım farklı günlerde ve otelin genelinde gerçekleşti. Şikayetimi otel yönetimiyle paylaştım fakat hiçbir şekilde yardımcı olmadılar. Burada geçirdiğim vakit benim için tam anlamıyla hayal kırıklığı oldu. review_text: Otelde 4 gece konakladım ve otelden yarı parasını peşin ödeyerek Rez yaptım. Ödediğim paranın karşılığı kesinlikle yok. Kahvaltı rezalet, masaya servis ediliyor, 30/40 dk bekledikten sonra.. sanırsınız ala carte sipariş verdik. ürünler oldukça vasat. Bayat ekmek ve simitle beraber servis ediliyor. Son gün yumurtamın içerisinden garip maddeler çıktı, bir çatal aldım şap gibi tuz. Aç kaldım. 3-5 çalışan var, her işe onlar koşmaya uğraşıyor. Hallerine üzüldüm doğrusu. 3 yetişkin için oda satın aldım ve telefonda da 3. Yatağın normal tek kişilik yatak olduğunu teyit ettim. Geldiğimizde odada çocuk yatağı vardı. Elinizle bastırdığınızda tahta elinize geliyor, tahtanın üzerine sünger koymuşlar. Ebat olarakta çocuk boy. Bir yetişkin kesinlikle sığmaz. Bu yatak için benden 7000 tl aldılar. Tartışma ile yatağı değiştirttik. İşletme müdürü oteli beğenmediyseniz çıkıp gidebilirsiniz dedi. Elimizde evcil hayvanımızla yer bulamayacağımızı bildiği halde. Otele yarı parasını ödemiş olmama rağmen diğer yarısını ödemem için ilk gün plajda iken resepsiyondan çağırdılar. Memnuniyetsizliğimi belirttiğim için ödemeden kaçarım diye düşündüler sanırım. Havuz küçücük, çocuk bile girmez. Anlayacağınız fiyatı 1/3 olsaydı otelden memnun kalabilirdim. Hayatımda böyle kazıklanmamıştım gerçekten. Resepsiyondaki bayana da bunu söylediğimde burası Türkbükü normal dedi. Ne oluyormuş Türkbükü olunca, ben birşey görmedim. Önce hizmet vereceksiniz ondan sonra karşılığını isteyeceksiniz.

Auch wenn der Preis im Vergleich mit anderen Hotels in der Gegend in Ordnung war, passte das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis aufgrund der genannten Punkte unterm Strich nicht wirklich. Vielleicht ist es in der High-Season besser. Potenzial ist jedenfalls vorhanden.

review_text: Arts Hotel Yalıkavak’ta geçirdiğimiz tatilden son derece memnun ayrıldık. Bu güzel deneyimin en büyük nedeni ise otelin her köşesinde hissedilen samimiyet ve misafirperverlikti. Öncelikle otel müdürü Yakup Bey’e özellikle teşekkür etmek isteriz. Her gün otelde misafirlerle tek tek ilgilenmesi, hâl hatır sorması ve her şeyin yolunda olduğundan emin olmaya çalışması gerçekten çok değerliydi. Böyle bir ilgi her otelde karşılaşılan bir durum değil. Kahvaltısı tam kararındaydı. Gereksiz şekilde yüzlerce çeşit sunmak yerine, kaliteli malzemelerle hazırlanmış, çok lezzetli ve yeterli bir kahvaltı vardı. Bizim için kalite, çeşitten çok daha önemliydi ve bu konuda gerçekten çok başarılıydılar. Otelde bulunan sushi ve İtalyan restoranlarında da akşam yemeklerinden çok memnun kaldık. Lezzetler oldukça başarılıydı ve keyifle vakit geçirdik. Resepsiyondan vale ekibine, garsonlardan housekeeping personeline kadar herkes son derece güler yüzlü, ilgili ve pozitifti. Özellikle vale ekibindeki beyefendinin ismini maalesef hatırlayamıyoruz ama her karşılaşmamızda kibarlığı ve enerjisiyle bizi gülümsetti. Otele daha ilk girişten itibaren kendinizi gerçekten hoş karşılanmış hissediyorsunuz. Otelin hem ortak alanları hem de odaları pırıl pırıldı. Temizlik konusunda gösterilen özen her an hissediliyordu. Plajda bizimle ilgilenen Fatmanur ve Tuğba’ya da ayrıca çok teşekkür ederiz. Samimiyetleri, güler yüzleri ve pozitif enerjileri tatilimizi daha da keyifli hale getirdi. Bir diğer bizi çok mutlu eden konu ise otelin hayvan dostu yaklaşımıydı. Evcil hayvan sahipleri için böyle sıcak ve anlayışlı bir ortam sunmaları gerçekten takdire değer. Kısacası, Arts Hotel Yalıkavak’ta geçirdiğimiz tatili unutulmaz kılan sadece otelin konumu ya da olanakları değil; bunu mümkün kılan, işini severek yapan harika ekibiydi. Emeği geçen tüm personele gönülden teşekkür ediyor, en kısa zamanda tekrar görüşmeyi diliyoruz.

review_text: Das Hotel hat mir insgesamt gut gefallen. Die Zimmer sind sauber, modern und hochwertig eingerichtet. Man merkt, dass hier Wert auf Qualität gelegt wird. Auch das Personal war freundlich, ich habe mich wohlgefühlt. Allerdings gab es ein paar Dinge, die mich gestört haben: Das Frühstück war ziemlich einfach – ich hätte mir ein Serpme Kahvaltı gewünscht, also ein typisches, vielfältiges türkisches Frühstück mit mehr Auswahl und Liebe zum Detail. Was mich wirklich enttäuscht hat, war die Sauberkeit am Strand. Abends lag Müll im Sand & Meer, was ich persönlich sehr unangenehm und unhygienisch finde. Auch der Pool hätte sauberer sein können – dort war das Wasser nicht ganz sauber. Insgesamt war der Aufenthalt trotzdem angenehm, aber bei einem Hotel dieser Klasse hätte ich in diesen Punkten mehr erwartet.

review_text: Das Hotel hat auf den ersten Blick einen wirklich tollen Eindruck gemacht – sehr stilvoll, elegant und mit einer luxuriösen Atmosphäre. Die Zimmer und die gesamte Einrichtung wirken hochwertig, und ich habe mich direkt wohlgefühlt. Besonders loben möchte ich das Personal, alle waren sehr freundlich, aufmerksam und hilfsbereit. Ein großes Dankeschön auch dafür, dass ich das Zimmer deutlich länger als geplant nutzen durfte – das war sehr nett. Etwas enttäuschend war für mich der Zustand von Strand und Pool – hier hätte ich mir bei einem Hotel dieser Kategorie deutlich mehr Sauberkeit und Pflege gewünscht. Auch das Frühstück konnte leider nicht ganz überzeugen, es war eher einfach gehalten. Ich hätte persönlich ein typisch türkisches Serpme Kahvaltı gewünscht, Serpme Kahvaltı hätte das Ganze deutlich aufgewertet. Insgesamt finde ich, dass das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis nicht ganz passt, weshalb ich vermutlich nicht noch einmal buchen würde.

review_text: Небольшой пи , уютный буи отель притаился среди холмов. Имеет собственный пляж с большим количеством лежаков расположенных как на пирсе, так и на берегу. В отеле всего 32 номера, лежаков штук 100, может даже больше. Днём еще лежаки ставят на небольшую платформу, вечером их убирают и выставляют на неё столы где проходят ужины. Единственный момент, во время уборки забывают добавлять воду, чай-кофе и гигиенические принадлежности. После обращения на ресепшен, все быстро приносят.

review_text: Staying at this hotel was the worst mistake of my life, and I have made plenty. Not only are rooms unclean and infested with black mould and damp, the WiFi does not work and staff are extremely rude and unpleasant. Upon arrival, we were shocked to discover a strong damp smell in the room and the bathroom was covered in mould. There was no wifi and the safe did not work. We then proceeded to ask for a different room and the girl at reception laughed in our face and said they were fully booked and that the website disclosed there was no WiFi in the rooms which was not true. We then complained to the woman at guest relations who said she could upgrade us to another room a few days later. We accepted this but stated we would want some reimbursement for the days we had to suffer in this room. We asked to speak to the manager and at first were told no but after insisting she eventually came out. Her extreme lack of English meant she did not understand what we were saying and much of the time was just ignoring us and staring at us blankly. Whenever she would reply, it would be ‘no why should I?’ Eventually we walked away defeated. Furthermore, the staff at reception all have an attitude problem and are not helpful when ordering taxis and visibly roll their eyes when asked. I don’t know what their problem is given Uber doesnt work there and it’s supposed to be a 5* hotel. The organisation of the taxis is also really bad and it’s confusing to know who’s taxi is whose so if you don’t sprint outside you will miss it. However I must say the valet staff are excellent and are the only helpful people in the entire hotel. They are the ones who sort out taxis in extremely hot weather and go above what their role entails. The hotel could learn a lot from them. Shoutout to Suleiman and Emihran from the valet service. Also bear in mind not many staff members speak English in this hotel even though the website says differently. If you get a room on the ground floor, beware as it seems the mould comes in from the swimming pool. DO NOT BOOK THIS PLACE!!!!!! I can ensure you will be disappointed.

Restaurants you had three to choose from, the main one, one by the pool and a La carte restaurants, we only used the main one and the one by the pool. The staff in both are helpful, friendly and are willing to help you with anything. The pool bar restaurant all the food is cooked fresh so it was always very busy from burgers to sea bass fish fillets. The only problem is if you are looking for a full English breakfast you will be unlucky because they don’t do them, eggs, scrambled, fried and omelettes the rest was your continental type breakfast. Lunch was good but had better, the evening meal was very good with sweets to die for. If you want a full English then go to the back of the Hotel as if going to the beach and turn right walk up about three minutes and on the left is a bar called SALT they do one for about £10. Entertanment, well you could say what entertainment because they had live bands, non very good live bands and two dance groups one from Columbia and One from Brazil, The animation team well that's the best thing I can say about them.

review_text: This was our first time to a beach resort in Turkey (have only been to Istanbul before) and certainly won’t be our last. The hotel is fabulous. The art is out of this world, some really amazing pieces. We were upgraded to a suite, being an Accor member, and the room was great. Fabulous sea views. Lovely bathroom amenities. Bottled water provided daily. The only negative was that turndown at night was a bit hit and miss as to whether it happened. Breakfast is a very good spread of food. Lots of fresh fruit and predominantly hot Turkish dishes. Eggs can be cooked on request, although not poached for some reason. Esra was particularly helpful at getting my husband’s eggs cooked to how he likes them. We ate in the restaurant on our first night, following a long day of travel. The food was very nice but the menu, in our opinion, was too bulk standard Mediterranean and not local dishes such as meze or fresh fish dishes. Prices fairly high too. The hotel is in a fabulous location with Yalikavak town on your doorstep, if you are prepared to walk. Turn left out of the hotel and walk down the road a short distance. Take the first right and at the end turn left, walking through the boat yard. You then literally follow the road all the way along the edge of the sea into town. You pass various little bars/restaurants and some small Turkish hotels before reaching the main part, where there are lots of restaurants, then some shops and eventually after a long walk, you’ll get to the Marina. Probably to where the main group of restaurants are, is around 25-30 min flat easy walk. The food in these restaurants is excellent. Fabulous fish and good prices. The Turkish people are extremely friendly and wanting to chat, both in the hotel and in town. We wouldn’t hesitate in recommending the hotel and we absolutely will be returning. I think we’ve found our new holiday destination! Thank you to all of the staff and the GM, who was very approachable and happy to chat.

review_text: My daughter and I stayed at Sirene Luxury Hotel and were absolutely blown away by the incredible views—they are truly the highlight of the resort. What made our stay particularly special, however, was the staff. From Adalet and Dilara at reception to everyone working in the restaurants and beach bar, the service was warm, attentive and genuinely welcoming. Prices throughout the resort are also firmly at the luxury end—even by five-star hotel standards—so it is worth being prepared for this. Bodrum itself is extraordinarily expensive during August, and in hindsight, this is probably not the best time of year to visit if value for money is important. Overall, the spectacular setting and exceptional staff were what made our stay memorable. The team is a real credit to the hotel.

There are multiple pools depending on which section of the hotel you're staying in, so they tend to be quiet and not overcrowded. review_text: We stayed here for 7 nights for our honeymoon and it was wonderful. The location is good for proximity to restaurants, bars and nightlife - we would recommend a rental car though if you ever want to get out of Yalikavak or do day trips. The hotel has an amazing view because it’s up a steep hill, so it’s not really walkable. It’s a 5-10 min taxi for about 100TL to get to the seaside/out for the evening. There are lots of shops nearby which are good for stocking up on snacks and drinks for your room. You’ll see these on the way over from the airport. Our sea view room was better than it looks in photos. Amazing view, pool on our doorstep (we mostly had it to ourselves, and you can also use any of the other 3 pools in the hotel. We were in Villa A, where the pool ends up in shade for most of the day. The other 3 pools were warmer so we often used those), massive bed, walk-in wardrobe and lovely toiletries. Bottled water and ice is provided for free, which is a nice touch. The staff are super attentive. Breakfast is served on the terrace. You get a spread of starters, and can choose two mains per person. Eggs, French toast, etc all delicious. Reception staff were also helpful, and offer lifts to places where possible. The restaurant is also good for lunch. The prices are similar to what we’d pay in London, but food is tasty and convenient (pastas, pizzas, salads and good cocktails). Happy hour is 4-6pm, with 50% off cold starters, sides and cocktails. The only downside, which isn’t the hotel’s fault, is the loud music from a nearby club which can be heard in the rooms until 2am. I suspect this starts around June and ends by the end of Sep? Not sure. If you are a very light sleeper (like me), it’s worth bringing some ear plugs. If not, then you’ve got nothing to worry about, as everything else is perfect. Things I wish I knew before I visited Yalikavak (we didn’t do much research before we went): - there are two marinas. The new one, with Zuma, Bagatelle, Nusret etc. this is fun and we visited a couple times. Feels a bit like Dubai, and everything is £££. Then the old marina, which is lovely and feels like ‘proper’ Turkey. We had better (and better value) meals here, staff were friendlier and more genuine, and the shops were authentic. We found it more difficult than we expected to to find a good local meal until we discovered the old marina - paşa döner was a nice quick lunch, and Arka Ristorante a good Italian dinner. - September really is considered the end of the season. We didn’t mind, but if you want a lively holiday in Bodrum where the beach clubs and restaurants are buzzing, go in July or august (probably June too, from what the locals told us). I think everything pretty much shuts down by the end of Sep. Thank you to everyone at the hotel - it was a memorable holiday for us :)

review_text: My second stay at The Bodrum EDITION somehow managed to exceed my already incredibly high expectations. This property is truly one of the most special hotels in the Marriott portfolio, and after extending our stay by an additional two nights, I was reminded why I never wanted to leave. As a Marriott Titanium Elite member, I was so grateful for a wonderful room upgrade, but what makes this hotel extraordinary goes far beyond the beautiful accommodations. From the moment we arrived until the moment we reluctantly departed, every single detail was flawless. The property itself is breathtaking. The architecture, design, beach, pool, restaurants, breakfast, and atmosphere create the perfect blend of luxury, relaxation, and understated elegance. Every corner feels thoughtfully curated, and it’s one of those rare places that instantly makes you feel at home while still feeling incredibly exclusive. What truly sets The Bodrum EDITION apart, however, is its people. Buse, Guest Manager — There is simply no better word than exceptional. She embodies true luxury hospitality. Every interaction was genuine, thoughtful, and incredibly personal. By the time we left, I genuinely had tears in my eyes saying goodbye. She made us feel like family, and her kindness is something I will never forget. Aaron made every breakfast and every beach day feel special. He is one of the kindest, most attentive, and genuinely caring people I’ve encountered in hospitality. His warmth and attention to detail never went unnoticed. Burak was an incredible driver who was always eager to help with absolutely anything. His positive attitude and willingness to go above and beyond made every transfer effortless. Nur has the sweetest soul. She constantly checked in to make sure everything was perfect and always greeted us with the warmest smile. Those small moments made such a big impact. Ufuk at the beach became someone we genuinely looked forward to seeing every day. His service was impeccable, his energy infectious, and he made every beach experience feel personalized and memorable. Natalie also brought such wonderful energy to the beach. Friendly, welcoming, and always making sure guests were having a great experience. David at Concierge, who helped us navigate a stressful situation when my friend’s luggage was lost. His professionalism and dedication were incredibly appreciated. Luxury hotels can have beautiful buildings, stunning beaches, and gorgeous pools. What cannot be replicated is a team that genuinely cares about every guest. That is exactly what The Bodrum EDITION has. I’ve stayed at many luxury properties around the world, and very few leave such a lasting impression. This one does. It’s not just because of the spectacular setting—it’s because of the extraordinary people who make you feel valued every single day. Thank you to the entire team for creating memories we’ll never forget. We will absolutely be back.

Until the very last moment at reception, I was assured that we would get interconnected rooms. However, when we arrived, it turned out the rooms were only next to each other, not connected inside. This forced me into an absurd situation on my own birthday – having to choose whether to stay with my husband or with my child. An absolutely unacceptable and upsetting start. I was given promises all day that they would “do their best,” but in the end, I was offered “joining rooms” again instead of truly interconnected rooms. review_text: Stayed for a week at The Bodrum Edition in early September. I’ve stayed at quite a few Marriotts recently, including the W Hotel in Verbier a few times in the last 18 months, so I was curious to try the EDITION brand as I understood it to be more boutique in style. On arrival it didn’t disappoint, suitably luxurious with a really slick welcome and even 4 different hotel-made ice creams to try in reception which was a nice touch. The drive from Bodrum Airport is a bit longer than ideal at around 50 minutes, but it’s fine. What you don’t realise until you check Google Maps is that the hotel isn’t in Bodrum town itself but about 30 minutes north near Yalıkavak. I was genuinely blown away by the quality of the area, very Mediterranean Riviera with high-end homes and boutique hotels. Compared to some parts of Greece where things often look half finished, here it felt properly done and very upmarket and not what I expected. Check-in was smooth. We had connecting rooms as we were travelling with our adult children. I used points for a Deluxe King, and they had the adjoining twin which we paid full price for. Their room was labelled as “garden view” but in reality it had the same view as ours which was a pleasant surprise. Worth pointing out that all rooms face north, so don’t expect sunshine on the balconies during the day. Some of the lower-level rooms also just look onto walls or retaining structures with planting. That said, our setup worked brilliantly. The space was huge, probably one of the best hotel rooms I’ve had, and the big balconies were great for evenings. This isn’t really a hotel for younger kids. There were a couple of families, but there’s no entertainment or kids’ focus. Food and the general vibe are more adult-orientated, which suited us perfectly. The only thing to be aware of is that the property also runs as a beach club during the day and open to external guests. This is common now in swanky resorts. It means there are cabanas and roped-off areas for paying guests, whether they are staying at the hotel or visiting for the day. On the first afternoon we unknowingly sat in a reserved spot which felt a bit awkward, especially as we were already there for the week as hotel guests and paying a reasonable amount of money. For a moment I questioned my choice of hotel. Once we figured it out, though, it was absolutely fine and for the rest of the stay we never had a problem finding sunbeds or a good spot. The cabanas themselves are very smart and a nice treat for a day, stocked with drinks, fruit and snacks. The pool only really filled up after lunch, but even then there were still beds available. September is worth noting too. It’s the end of the Turkish holiday season, so the hotel got noticeably quieter after the first week. Some people would love that, but the evenings were very subdued and most guests headed into Yalıkavak Marina instead, which was buzzing and had some brilliant restaurants. The hotel facilities are top-notch.

review_text: Otelde konaklama yapmadığım için , sizlerle sadece günlük olarak kullandığım , otele ait olan X Beach ile ilgili yaşamış olduğum berbat tecrübemi paylaşmak isterim . Evim Yalıkavak ta olduğu için , deniz imkanından yararlanabilmek adına , evimede yakın olması nedeniyle X Beach e gitmek istedim . Gitmeden evvel telefonla arayarak günlük ücret ve alacağım hizmet konusunda bilgi rica ettim . Hatta Esra Hanım isimli görevli hanım , bana aylık girişlerim için indirimli bir fiyat bile verdi . Girişte alınan ücretin , içeride olan kullanımıma istinaden yansıtılacağını ı ve eğer fazla miktarda kullanım yaparsam üzerini ödemem gerektiği bilgisini verdi . Bu konu ile ilgili ise defalarca üst yönetimiyle görüşerek , onay aldığını belirterek , bana geri döndü . Ben oraya gittiğimde ise Esra Hanım işten ayrıldı , böyle bir uygulamamız yok diyerek , son derece ilgisiz , son derece profesyonel olmayan , sorumlu kişilerden servis yapan personele kadar , kapı girişinde bile bir hoşgeldiniz / güle güle denmeden karşılanıp uğurlanarak , hiç hoşnut kalmadığım bir kumsalda , anormal astronomik fiyatlarla berbat bir gün geçirdim . Keşke en azından ödediğim paranın karşılığını alabilmiş olsaydım . Otoparkı ise her şeyden daha beter . Arabamı kendim park etmiş olmama rağmen , kapıya yazılan bir " vale servisimiz ücretlidir " yazısına istinaden ücret ödemek zorunda kalmam ve saygısız davranışlı personelininde , aldıkları ücrete karşılık fiş bile vermedikleri için en azından yetkililerce denetlenmesi gerektiğini düşünüyorum . Bodrum ' da verilen paranın karşılığını alabileceğiniz bir çok işletme var iken bu tarz beach lerin kullanılmaması gerektiğini düşünüyorum .
